harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as the signed offline-rhel8 HTTP repository on TCP 8080. Node2 enforces repository and RPM signature checks, uses priorities 10/90, and can install and reinstall zsh with all other repositories disabled. Both nodes retained full functionality across verified sequential reboots.
actions_performed: Published zsh and 160 dependency RPMs with generated repository metadata.
Generated a repository signing key, signed repomd.xml, and published both required public keys.
Enabled persistent Apache service, SELinux access, and firewall access on TCP 8080.
Configured node2 with gpgcheck=1, repo_gpgcheck=1, offline priority 10, and other enabled repositories priority 90.
Installed and repeatedly reinstalled zsh using only offline-rhel8.
Sequentially rebooted node1 and node2 and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Publish zsh, dependencies, metadata, signing key, and signed metadata
evidence.summary: The repository contains 161 RPMs; metadata, detached signature, and public keys are published. Node2 directly verified a good RSA metadata signature.

evidence.requirement: Serve offline-rhel8 over HTTP on TCP 8080
evidence.summary: Apache is enabled and active on TCP 8080 and serves repository metadata, including after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Enforce repository/RPM verification and repository priorities
evidence.summary: Effective settings show gpgcheck=1, repo_gpgcheck=1, offline-rhel8 priority 10, and both other enabled repositories priority 90.

evidence.requirement: Install and keep zsh reinstallable with every other repository disabled
evidence.summary: zsh was installed and reinstalled exclusively from offline-rhel8; the installed RPM has a valid Red Hat RSA/SHA256 signature and remained reinstallable after both reboots.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from 352a7b75-b8c9-4d6c-8833-f0fa410191ed to 0977f790-4caa-4a8b-a302-bdcaab39fff3. Apache, TCP 8080, all 161 RPMs, and the unchanged signed metadata recovered.

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from a1be807a-f931-4328-b608-cd61f894ed55 to 4642e354-840a-4b68-925d-042905e4f7f8. zsh, signature policy, offline availability, and isolated reinstallability recovered.
